source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9.1, printed page 131 (Figure 6.5).

blocks.text: Jab ionic compounds pani mein ghulte hain to woh ions mein toot jate hain, aur phir pani ke molecules in ions ko gher lete hain.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.text: Woh process jis mein pani ke molecules solute ke ions ko gher lete hain aur un se interact karte hain, hydration kehlata hai.
Pani ke molecules aur ions ke darmiyan jo forces banti hain unhen ion-dipole forces kehte hain (Figure 6.5). Is wajah se aqueous solution ke sab ions hydrated kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf peele cations (+) aur hare anions (-) ki ionic lattice. Oopar pani ka ek molecule (surkh O aur do white H) apne O end se ek cation ki taraf khincha hai, O par delta- aur H par delta+; neeche pani ka molecule apne H ends se ek anion ki taraf khincha hai, H par delta+ aur O par delta-. Khamdar arrow lattice se ek hydrated cation tak jate hain jise chhe pani ke molecules O end andar kiye ghere hain, aur ek hydrated anion tak jise chhe molecules H end andar kiye ghere hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Hydration ke process se ionic compound ka ghulna (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani ke molecule ka oxygen wala end thoda negative (δ⁻) aur hydrogen wale ends thode positive (δ⁺) hain. Positive ion (Na⁺) ki taraf oxygen ki direction (rukh) hoti hai, aur negative ion (Cl⁻) ki taraf hydrogen ka. Har ion ke gird pani ka ek circle (ghera) ban jata hai.
Ion-dipole force ki wajah se attraction ki energy ko enthalpy of hydration kehte hain. Kitab is ki definition yun karti hai:

blocks.title: Enthalpy of hydration
blocks.text: Woh enthalpy change jo tab hoti hai jab solute ka ek mole zyada pani mein ghul kar standard conditions par infinitely dilute solution banaye.
Is ka symbol ΔHhyd hai. Yeh energy hamesha bahar nikalti hai, kyun ke is mein ion-dipole bond banta hai.
Factors Affecting the magnitude of Hydration Energy (hydration energy par asar dalne wale factors)
Heat of hydration in factors par depend karti hai:

In dono ko mila kar ek term istemal karte hain: “charge density”, yani per unit area charge. Chhote ion par zyada charge ho to charge density zyada hoti hai, aur ulta bhi. Zyada charge density wale ions ko pani ke molecules zor se khainchte hain, is liye hydration energy zyada hoti hai. Misal ke taur par in ions ki enthalpies of hydration ka order yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Ions mukhtalif size ke circles (dairon) ki shakal mein. Oopar wali line: bara circle Na+, phir chhota-hone ka nishan (<), darmiyana circle Mg2+, phir <, chhota circle Al3+ (Na+ < Mg2+ < Al3+). Neeche wali line: chhota circle Mg2+, phir bara-hone ka nishan (>), darmiyana circle Ca2+, phir >, bara circle Sr2+ (Mg2+ > Ca2+ > Sr2+).
blocks.caption: Enthalpy of hydration ki tarteeb: Na⁺ < Mg²⁺ < Al³⁺ aur Mg²⁺ > Ca²⁺ > Sr²⁺; har ion ka circle us ka nisbati size dikhata hai (kitab mein caption nahi).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Pehli line: Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺ mein charge 1, 2, 3 barhta hai aur size chhota hota hai, is liye hydration energy barhti hai. Doosri line: Mg²⁺, Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺ ka charge ek jaisa (2+) hai magar group mein neeche size barhta hai, is liye hydration energy kam hoti hai.
Isi basis par anions (manfi ions) ki hydration energy bhi samjhai ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Do ions ka charge ek jaisa hai magar ek chhota hai; do aur ions ka size ek jaisa hai magar ek par zyada charge hai. Har pair mein kis ki enthalpy of hydration zyada exothermic hogi?
blocks.explanation: Chhote ion ki, aur zyada charge wale ion ki. Dono ki charge density zyada hai, is liye woh pani ke dipoles ko zyada zor se khainchte hain aur zyada energy nikalti hai.

items: Hydration: pani ke molecules ion-dipole forces se ions ko gherte hain; ΔHhyd hamesha release hoti hai.
Charge density (zyada charge, chhota size) barhe to hydration energy barhti hai: Na⁺ < Mg²⁺ < Al³⁺; Mg²⁺ > Ca²⁺ > Sr²⁺.
